uhc.text: Electrocardiogram (ECG) prices for UnitedHealthcare commercial plans vary across hospitals. The lowest price is $40.48 at Chandler Regional Medical Center, and the highest price is $565 at St Josephs Hospital And Medical Center. Most prices fall between $69.09 and $455, and the highest price is 14.0 times the lowest price.

bcbs_az.text: For an Electrocardiogram (ECG), Blue Cross Blue Shield of Arizona commercial plans report the highest price at $129, which is 4.8 times the lowest at $27.04. Most prices fall between $41.26 and $86.31.

aetna.text: Electrocardiogram (ECG) prices for Aetna with commercial (employer or individual) plans range from $14.46 to $585, with the highest price 40.5 times the lowest. The median price is $23.27, and most prices fall between $19.00 and $331 across 27 hospitals in 5 health systems.

cigna.text: An Electrocardiogram (ECG) billed to Cigna commercial plans has a lowest price of $96.92 and a highest price of $686. The highest price is 7.1 times the lowest price, and most prices fall between $289 and $355.

humana.text: For an Electrocardiogram (ECG) paid by Humana with commercial (employer or individual) plans, the lowest price is $20.72 at 5 HonorHealth hospitals and the highest price is $34.73 at Abrazo Arrowhead Hospital, which is 1.7 times the lowest. Most prices fall between $20.72 and $25.22.

cash.text: For an Electrocardiogram (ECG) billed at the cash (self-pay) price, hospital prices vary widely. The lowest price is $18.00 and the highest is $1,099, and most prices fall between $18.00 and $240. The highest price is 61.1 times the lowest, the median price is $116, and 86% of hospitals charge a cash price below the typical insured price.
